title: Spawnix
description: Control mob spawning the way Minecraft always should have, simple, natural, and in real time.
body:
## **🧠 Spawnix**
Control mob spawning the way Minecraft always should have.
Spawnix is a lightweight yet powerful mod that gives you full control over how mobs spawn, using Minecraft’s own spawning engine — not replacing it, not breaking it, just unlocking its real potential.

No weird systems.
No artificial mechanics.
Just clean, natural, real-time control.

## **📜 Commands & Examples**
Below are some practical examples showing what you can do with Spawnix using simple commands.

## **⚙️ Mobcap Control**
Adjust the global mobcap limit for an entire category.

/spawnix category monster cap 200

**Increases the mobcap limit for monsters to 200.**

## **🎯 Individual Mob Control**
Increase or completely disable the spawn of a specific entity.

/spawnix entity minecraft:creeper multiplier 5.0

**Creepers will spawn much more frequently.**

/spawnix entity minecraft:creeper multiplier 0

**Creepers will no longer spawn.**

## **🌍 Biome-Based Control**
Modify how a mob behaves inside a specific biome.

/spawnix biome desert minecraft:creeper priority 0

**Creepers will stop spawning in deserts.**

These examples represent only the most basic things you can do with Spawnix.

## **⚙️ Features**
🎯 Individual mob control

🌍 Biome-based spawning

🔥 Dimension-based spawning (Overworld, Nether, End, modded dimensions)

🌧️ Weather conditions (rain, thunder, clear)

🌙 Moon phases

⏰ Day & night control

📅 World day counter

🧩 Fully combinable conditions

⚡ Real-time commands (no game restart, no server restart)

🧠 Uses Minecraft’s real spawning engine

🧱 Does NOT replace Mojang’s system

🧩 Designed for compatibility with mods that add mobs and biomes

## **📌 Notes**
Initial versions may receive frequent updates

Future versions will expand compatibility and features
